title: NIST AI Metrology Center — Phase 65 NIST ARIA assurance adoption review
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the NIST ARIA assurance adoption reporting pack. NIST curates AI measurement methods and maps them to lifecycle stages and trustworthiness characteristics.
key_findings: The resource is method-oriented rather than vendor-oriented.
Entries preserve method provenance and intended use.
NIST explicitly disclaims endorsement and universal fitness.
why_it_matters: Which records connect evaluation design and authorization to monitoring, incidents, correction, independent review, institutional use, and outcomes? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. It gives operators a practical selection layer between high-level risk management and system-specific evaluation.
ftfn_relevance: Advances one named Phase 55Y reader journey.
Separates the current evidence stage from downstream operation or outcome claims.
Creates a specific next-record watch point.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
A catalog entry is not a validated deployment control.
